entries.name: Reroll one die
entries.summary: Reroll any one die, yours or an opponent's; the new result stands. Spend more Edge to reroll more dice.

entries.name: Add 3 to Initiative Score
entries.summary: Raise your Initiative Score by 3, before combat starts or to move up the order on the next cycle.

entries.name: Add 1 to a single die
entries.summary: Raise one die by 1, for example a 4 to a 5 to gain a hit, or a 1 to a 2 to avoid a glitch.

entries.name: Give an ally 1 Edge
entries.summary: Spend 2 of your Edge to give a teammate 1.

entries.name: Negate 1 Edge of a foe
entries.summary: Spend 2 of your Edge to remove 1 from an opponent of your choice.

entries.name: Buy one automatic hit
entries.summary: Add one hit to your total. It is an extra hit, not an automatic success.

entries.name: Heal one box of Stun
entries.summary: Clear one box on your Stun monitor.

entries.name: Add Edge to the dice pool, 6s explode
entries.summary: Add your Edge attribute to the pool. Each 6 is a hit and is rolled again for another chance at a hit; a 1 rolled after a 6 does not count toward glitches.

entries.name: Heal one box of Physical
entries.summary: Clear one box on your Physical monitor.

entries.name: Reroll failed dice
entries.summary: After a roll, reroll every die that is not a hit. Not allowed after a glitch or critical glitch.

entries.name: 2s count as glitches for a target
entries.summary: On an opponent's roll, 2s count toward its glitch or critical glitch as well as 1s.

entries.name: Create a special effect
entries.summary: Something fortuitous happens that tilts the scene slightly in your favor; you and the gamemaster decide what.

entries.name: Shank
entries.summary: Turns your advantage into a targeted blade strike: the Called Shot penalty drops to -2.

entries.name: Sudden Insight
entries.summary: Use a skill you have no ranks in without the penalty, unless the skill cannot be used untrained.

entries.name: Tactical Roll
entries.summary: Drop prone without the usual prone penalty on a melee attack this round, and without the -2 against close or near attacks next round.

entries.name: Tumble
entries.summary: If the damage is greater than the target's Body, the target goes prone.

entries.name: Bring the Drama
entries.summary: Add dramatic flair to a con. A quick con can bring in 200 nuyen from onlookers; a longer one can raise the asking price by twenty percent.

entries.name: Fire from Cover
entries.summary: Attack from full cover without the -2 dice pool penalty.

entries.name: Knockout Blow
entries.requires: Melee Attack, after spending at least 1 Edge in the previous action
entries.summary: If the damage, of any type, is greater than the target's Willpower, fill their Stun monitor. They are unconscious and nothing overflows to Physical.

entries.name: Wrest
entries.summary: After a successful Block in melee, roll Close Combat + Agility against the attacker's Strength as the threshold: equal knocks the weapon away, more hits takes it.

entries.name: Anticipation
entries.summary: Fire at a spot, not a person: roll your full dice pool for each target.

entries.name: Big Speech
entries.summary: Roll Influence + Charisma twice; the first roll counts as a teamwork test whose hits add to the pool for the second, and the second gives your hits.

entries.name: Called Shot: Disarm
entries.summary: A successful hit does no damage, but the target's weapon is knocked from their hands.

entries.name: Called Shot: Vitals
entries.summary: Adds 3 damage if the attack hits, along with net hits as usual.

entries.name: Smackdown
entries.summary: Burn Edge for an automatic success on a test the character could attempt, with four net hits.

entries.name: Not Dead Yet
entries.summary: Burn Edge to survive a killing blow. It does not remove the character from the danger.
